text:
Chattanooga Lookouts, featuring former John Carroll Catholic High School standout Jay Allen II, lost 7-6 on Aug. 11
By
V. J. TorresAt 7:35 p.m. Tuesday, Aug. 11, the Chattanooga Lookouts, whose roster includes former John Carroll Catholic High School standout Jay Allen II, fell 7-6 to the Montgomery Biscuits in a MiLB game.
The game was played at DABOS Park. It was the teams' 13th meeting this season; the Lookouts lead the season series 7-6.
Allen II went 1-for-4, drew a walk, struck out once and left one runner on base.
The Lookouts are scheduled to play the Biscuits again at DABOS Park on Wednesday, Aug. 12.
Jay Allen II — Outfielder — 6′0″ — 200 — Hometown: Fort Pierce
